scene: The map safe inside, three departure gates await outside.
picture: Along the flat quay just beyond the arcade, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands with her bulging satchel. On the left, a green wooden river barge bobs at the jetty. At the centre, an ornate brass spiral lift cage stands open. On the right, a red cable tram sits waiting.
shown: a flat wooden river barge moored at a dock on the left
a glowing spiral lift cage sitting open at the centre
